Name: Gaston Le Mode (on TV)
Dialog: Behold! Feast your eyes upon the fashion of the future!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace. (said in the same manner as Isabella) What'cha waaaatchin'?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Only the latest looks from the world's greatest fashion designer, Gaston Le Mode.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I don't get it. Why would anyone want to wear such goofy looking clothes?

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's not goofy! Fashion designers create art. That people live in.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hmm. I never thought of it that way. (To Ferb) Ferb, put the Cold Fusion Reactor on hold!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (Pulls lever)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Gaston Le Mode (on TV)
Dialog: As now, to my world tour, I, Gaston Le Mode, will be at the...

Name: Voice-Over
Dialog: (dubbing over Le Mode) Googolplex Mall!

Name: Gaston Le Mode (on TV)
Dialog: ...today!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: 1, 2, 3, testing, testing, 1, 2, 3, testing-- (Camera shows that he is not wearing pants) Agent P, you're early! Carl, cut to close up! (Camera zooms in; to Perry) Oh. (Clears throat) B-Basically, Doofenshmirtz has been acting up again. He's er stockpiling the usual strange and unrelated items. This time, it's copy machines and ink cartridges by the thousands. We need you to find out what's going on right away.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Ferb. If we're gonna tackle this fashion design thing, we've gotta do something really special. It has to be cool. Comfortable. And undetectable by radar. Something that absolutely screams summer! Ah, I think you're on to something, Ferb!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (enters) Hey, Phineas. What'cha dooooin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb and I are working on designs for our new clothing line. Take a look at what we've got so far.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Very impressive! Need any help? (Shows the Fireside Girls holding dressmaking equipment) The Fireside Girls and I are trying to get our sewing badges.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Excellent. Let's go!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Woo hoo!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus! Let me show you something, "Mr. I Break Through Walls Whenever I Want"! (Button beeps and a robot arm holding a roll of duct tape pops out of the floor and tapes up the crack) There you go. Oh, one more thing! (Button beeps and the arm ties up Perry with the tape) Oh, look! I have captured the rare "DUCK-Taped Platypus"! (Laughs maniacally which fades into a nervous laugh) You know, like duck-billed... Never mind. Anyway, let me show you my evil plan. I call it the Copy and Paste-Inator! There's nothing I hate more than waiting in line. All the time wasted in stores, and amusement parks, where I could be spreading more evil in the Tri-State Area! I will make copies of myself, and they will do the waiting for me. I know, it sounds a little bit crazy but, look. You're all tied up. And (sits down in the Inator seat) And I am stepping into a giant copy machine to make duplicates of myself. (has crazy eyes as he say the next words) Who's crazy now? (Electricity zapping as the Inator closes)

Name: Candace
Dialog: There it is; The world's famous runway of Gaston Le Mode. Oh, Stacy, can you imagine the glamorous life of a supermodel?

Name: Supermodel Candace
Dialog: Hi, I'm Candace. I'm sure you recognize me from my countless magazine covers. You know, being a supermodel is hard work; The bright lights, the deafening applause, and all those paper cuts from counting my huge stacks of money. That's why I start every morning with Candace Os.

Name: Man
Dialog: Candace Os. Part of a nutritious breakfast.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace Os?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Sighs) I really shouldn't fantasize on an empty stomach.

Name: Man #2
Dialog: (Gasps)

Name: Gaston Le Mode
Dialog: Finally! After years of bitter struggle, I, Gaston Le Mode, have created the ultimate design; The ne plus ultra in haute couture. But alas, I cannot find a single model with a neck long enough to complement my design.

Name: Woman
Dialog: Sorry, Gaston, but only someone with a freakishly long neck could fit into--

Name: Gaston Le Mode
Dialog: Yes. Everyone is sorry. Where will I find that swan-like neck?

Name: Man #2
Dialog: Pardon, Monsieur, I have great news!

Name: Gaston Le Mode
Dialog: (excitedly) A Jerry Lewis marathon on TV tonight?

Name: Man #2
Dialog: I wish! But no. Better yet, I have found her!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hi.

Name: Man #2
Dialog: Look at this! Mon Dieu! It is perfection!

Name: Gaston Le Mode
Dialog: You are my Cou De Crayon.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Your Cou De Crayon? Cool!

Name: Gaston Le Mode
Dialog: Allez! Allez! Let's get you to makeup.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Screams)  I think I just tanned my eyeballs. Ugh. Now, with the push of a button, I will make history! (Laughs maniacally) By the way, do you like my mural? I did it myself, it's a silhouette of me going... (Laughs maniacally; Pushes button) All right, let's see, now. (Ding) Oh, needs a little more toner. Oh, copy jam.

Name: Doofenshmirtz #2
Dialog: Duh...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Why is it when people copy their butts, it comes out perfect?

Name: Gaston Le Mode
Dialog: We're almost ready. now, let me see. (Candace turns around) Oh! Absolutely beautiful!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (blushes) Oh, why, thank you!

Name: Gaston Le Mode
Dialog: Now, wait right here while I introduce you to the crowd.

Name: Delivery Guy
Dialog: Package for Gaston Le Mode.

Name: Gaston Le Mode
Dialog: (excitedly) Is it a poster of Jerry Lewis?

Name: Delivery Guy
Dialog: I wish!

Name: Gaston Le Mode
Dialog: All right, all right. But this better be important. (unrolls the paper) Ooh! Gasp! This design! It's comfortable. Cool. And undetectable by radar. It absolutely screams summer!

Name: Candace
Dialog: This isn't new! I've seen this before!

Name: Gaston Le Mode
Dialog: Do you know who designed it?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We did, sir. It's part of the Phineas and Ferb Summer All The Time collection.

Name: Gaston Le Mode
Dialog: C'est magnifique!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What are you guys doing here?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's all thanks to you, Candace. We thought fashion design was lame, but you convinced us to give the glamor world a chance.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But-but-but-but--

Name: Gaston Le Mode
Dialog: Mademoiselle, Candace, there has been a change in plans. You will put this on, s'il vous plait.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I-I-I--

Name: Gaston Le Mode
Dialog: Or you could wear this.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Not in this life! Sayonara, amigo! (stomps across the runway in anger) I am so telling Mom, and you guys are so busted! (falls into the crowd) I'm okay!

Name: Gaston Le Mode
Dialog: But mademoiselle! Sigh. Okay, ladies, time to get changed and strut your stuff.

Name: Women
Dialog: Thank you, Gaston.

Name: Gaston Le Mode
Dialog: Ladies and Gentlemen, I, Gaston Le Mode, am proud to present this stunning new collection: Summer All The Time.

Name: Gaston Le Mode
Dialog: And give a big hand to the designers, my latest discovery, (Snapshot) Phineas and Ferb!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, Ferb. Our designs have really caught on.

Name: Gaston Le Mode
Dialog: Everyone who is anyone is now wearing Summer All The Time.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Not a bad morning's work.

Name: Woman #2
Dialog: Nice outfit, handsome.

Name: Gaston Le Mode
Dialog: You are on fire.

Name: Candace
Dialog: When Mom hears about this-- (Sees two people) Hey, wait a minute. Where did you get those outfits?

Name: Woman #3
Dialog: These? Why, they're only the latest hit designs from the Summer All The Time collection. Everybody's wearing them. I mean, jeez, where you been?

Name: Candace
Dialog: "Phineas and Ferb, The Kings of Couture!"? That was fast.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace? There you are!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You left your cell phone and your clothes in there.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Gasps) Stacy? You too?! You look just like Ferb!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Wow, thanks, Candace! Most of this is a genuine label, but the shoes are total knockoffs. I heard there's a riot Uptown at this one store that got a fresh shipment. I gotta run before they sell out. (walks off) Bye! (comes back) Oh, and Candace? Friendly tip; That Gaston stuff is so 42 seconds ago. (walks away again)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Growls)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You see, Perry the Platypus, a whole army of Doofenshmirtzs! Perfect copies of me!

Name: Doofenshmirtz #3
Dialog: Hiya, handsome.

Name: Doofenshmirtz #4
Dialog: Right back at ya, fella.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You, here! Grab me some corn dogs!

Name: Doofenshmirtz #5
Dialog: Sure thing!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You, fetch me some movie tickets!

Name: Doofenshmirtz #6
Dialog: You bet your britches!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And you, go ride that new rollercoaster a couple of times, okay?

Name: Doofenshmirtz #7
Dialog: Okey-Dokey!

Name: Doofenshmirtz 8
Dialog: Oh, me too!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Go, go, my facsimiles! Go wait in line so that I never have to!

Name: Doofenshmirtzs
Dialog: (Cheering)/Geronimo!/Whoopee!/Santa Claus!/Native American icon!/Hey, there's the mall!/Well, that was fun!/Ooh, what fun!/Oh, I landed in a puddle.

Name: Doofenshmirtzs
Dialog: Look at the puppies!/I can get these glasses for 10 bucks? What a deal! (All talking at once)

Name: Man
Dialog: Hey, you see what these people are wearing?

Name: Woman #3
Dialog: Some kind of retro pharmacist outfit.

Name: Man
Dialog: I feel so 2 minutes and 5 seconds ago.

Name: Woman #3
Dialog: Hey, let's get back in style!

Name: Doofenshmirtz #8
Dialog: Now I have two!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aren't they adorable? How about you jump, and fetch me something too, huh? Something like, mmm, your doom?

Name: Doofenshmirtz #2
Dialog: Hey, don't hurt the little bunny rabbit.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: How did you get out of the trash, you drop-out bohemian? (To Perry) I'll be right back. I've got some deleting to do. That's right, tremble, my rejected friend. (accidentally presses the "Delete All" button) Oh no! I pushed the "Delete All" button by mistake!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Look what you made me do! Oh, guess who's paying for this! (Perry ties Doof's hands with the duct tape) What is this? (Perry jumps out) Hey, why did you jump out that-- (Gasps) Oh, you clever, little plat-- (gets dragged out) Well, that wasn't very bright! Now we're both going-- (gets wrapped around the gutter of a plane) CURSE YOU, PERRY THE PLATYPUS!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Come on, Mom, you want to see something crazy?!!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (flatly) Oooh, I think I'm looking at it...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Look, Mom! You see?!! (Points, then, after a moment, looks downward, deadpanned)

Name: Linda
Dialog: So you dragged me all the way down here for a...pharmacist convention?

Name: Gaston Le Mode
Dialog: Face it, mon ami, your designs are so 3 minutes and 37 seconds ago.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, well. We had a great time. Hey, Gaston? What's with the new outfit?

Name: Gaston Le Mode
Dialog: Are you kidding? No one's claiming this look yet! I have to get out in front of this thing and take credit for it all. That's how you stay ahead in this business, kid. Au revoir!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, Phineas, I still like your style.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Thanks. (To Linda) Hi, Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, look. We're all here. Why don't we all get some lunch? (leaving) I think there's a pizza place right over there.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, go ahead. Eat all you want. My dreams are smashed to pieces, and all you can think of is food! Well, just remember, Gaston said I'll always be his Cou de Crayon.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: You do realize that that's French for "Pencil Neck"?
